title: Block file scheme in Web Request Helper
summary: Web Request Helper now rejects file:// URLs before creating HTTP requests to prevent unauthorized local file access through crafted URLs.
key_points: Added validation to block file URI scheme in GetResponseTextInternal
File URLs are rejected with a false return instead of unhandled error
No behavior change for http/https URLs
Reuses existing IsValidUri and IsSecureHttpUrl scheme checks
Security fix preventing server-side file read attacks
